Introduction: Humedix Revolline HA dermal filler family. HARA-L official brochure confirms 19mg/mL cross-linked sodium hyaluronate + 1mg/mL sodium hyaluronate + 0.3% lidocaine, 1mL/syringe, 2 syringes/box, 27G and 30G needles, and approved use for temporary improvement of adult moderate-to-severe nasolabial folds. Humedix official pages list Revolline-L and Contour-L. Volume such as 3mL is treated as a specification or packaging variant rather than a standalone product line.
